records.generatedCopy: Qwen Code 0.21.1 exposes a useful AI-agent control pattern: stop polling CI inside the agent turn and finalize only after the workflow reaches a terminal state. This guide adds a commit-bound handoff contract, a closed-green approval gate, and eight acceptance tests for preventing stale evidence and early approvals. Use it when a review agent can finish before CI does.

AI review agents should reason about code—not burn their turn polling CI.

This checklist separates review from waiting with a commit-bound handoff, a workflow_run finalizer, and eight fail-closed tests. #AIAgents #DevOps
